_about: Tributes for named pilots (special NPCs) on the Memorial Wall (MemorialWall.tribute_of), keyed by callsign. A named pilot's record page shows its tribute; one with no entry here shows Lorem Ipsum. The texts are placeholders for Yosqi to write.
